content.short: 3x Education prepares aspiring Web3 venture capital professionals with training, hands-on experience, and portfolio-building opportunities.
content.description: 3x Education bridges the gap for aspiring Web3 venture capital professionals by delivering comprehensive training and hands-on experience through programs led by seasoned venture capitalists. In these programs, participants study startup analysis and portfolio construction, blending theoretical knowledge with practical application to prepare for roles in the Web3 venture capital ecosystem, equipping learners to apply core concepts to real-world startup and portfolio scenarios within this evolving space.
content.meta: 3x Education trains aspiring professionals for careers in Web3 venture capital. Discover 3x Education and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
